code: for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA('ScreenGui') then g.Enabled=false end end local RS=game:GetService('RunService') pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep('MareShot') end) RS:BindToRenderStep('MareShot',Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function() local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera local cf=workspace:GetAttribute('ShotCF') if cf then cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.CFrame=cf cam.FieldOfView=workspace:GetAttribute('ShotFov') or 65 end end) local ch=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then ch.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true end workspace:SetAttribute('DevGod',true) return 'cam'

local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local FS=require(RS.Shared.FieldScene) workspace:SetAttribute('VoyageActive',true) task.spawn(function() local ok,err=xpcall(function() return FS.start({name='솔즈베리 평원',portId='london',nodes=2,danger=5,seed=9,onFinish=function() end}) end,function(e) return debug.traceback(tostring(e)) end) workspace:SetAttribute('FieldErr',tostring(ok)..' '..tostring(err)) end) task.wait(3) local g=workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene') and workspace.FieldScene:FindFirstChild('FieldGround') local L=game:GetService('Lighting') local n=0 for _,m in workspace.FieldScene:GetChildren() do if m.Name=='FieldEnemy' then n+=1 end end local sz=g and g.Size.X or 0 local o=Vector3.new(3000,0,0) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',70) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(o+Vector3.new(0,38,sz/2+22),o+Vector3.new(0,2,sz/2-60))) return '솔즈베리 평원/london size='..sz..' enemies='..n..' fog='..L.FogEnd..' clock='..L.ClockTime..' err='..tostring(workspace:GetAttribute('FieldErr'))
